// the two specifiers that separate "relative to the importer" from
// "relative to the root": `../b.ts` only resolves by walking UP out of sub/,
// and `./c.ts` resolves to sub/c.ts while a root-relative join finds the
// decoy c.ts and reports a WRONG file rather than none.
import { v1 } from '../b.ts';
import { cc } from './c.ts';
// the BARE FORM of a node builtin. Measured over this repository: all 371
// builtin imports are `node:`-prefixed and not one is written this way, so
// without this line the vocabulary branch of the shape rule is a rule nothing
// exercises — invisible to every gate, which is the failure mode CLAUDE.md
// names for opt-in features.
import { join } from 'path';
export const deep = [v1, cc, join];
